title: The bird in the vault (replica)
description: A jewelled clockwork bird in gold and enamel, sitting in the vault's display case. It sings when wound. Odile Marchetti says it is a replica.
collection: Recovered by the detective, photographed in the case, bagged and sealed.

analyses.label: Materials and tool-mark analysis of the replica
analyses.findings: Brass under gold leaf, modern resin-based enamel cured within the last three weeks. Tool marks from a jeweller's micro-graver; the maker's mark was copied from photographs. This was made recently, by hand, by a skilled enamel restorer.

addsPoints.note: The replica is recent work by a skilled enamel restorer.

title: Vault access log
description: Vault door controller, Monday to Thursday. Mon 23:08 — code IVANCE (restoration return). Wed 01:12 — code FDORN; door closed 01:46. Thu 21:05 — code OMARCHETTI (appraisal).
collection: Exported by the detective in the presence of the gallery manager; hash recorded.

points.note: His code opened the vault at 01:12 on Wednesday.
She was alone in the vault on Monday night returning the bird.

limitations.text: The log records codes, not people, and the owner's master override does not write to it at all.

title: Vault corridor CCTV
description: Corridor camera, Monday to Thursday. Monday 23:00–23:20: no footage — recording paused. Wednesday 01:10: a man in a hooded jacket with a tool bag walks to the vault; leaves 01:47.

points.note: A man with a tool bag in the vault corridor on Wednesday night.
The camera was paused exactly while she was in the vault on Monday.

limitations.text: The Wednesday figure's face is never visible.

analyses.label: Security desk console activity review
analyses.findings: The Monday pause was entered at the security desk console at 22:59. On Wednesday the desk console shows no activity at all between 23:40 and 04:55: no hourly round was checked in.

addsPoints.note: The camera was paused from the guard's desk a minute before she entered the vault.

title: Restoration work order
description: Gallery work order: the Nightingale signed out to Irene Vance's studio for cleaning and enamel repair, ten days; signed back in Monday 23:08, 'condition as received'.

points.note: She had the bird alone in her studio for ten days.

limitations.text: A restorer handling the object is exactly what she was hired to do.

title: Insurance policy
description: The Nightingale's policy. Cover raised from 2.0 million to 3.5 million last month, signed by Lucien Ravel.

points.note: He raised the cover by 1.5 million weeks before the theft.

limitations.text: The policy shows who signed, not who asked for the increase.

title: Lucien Ravel's bank statements
description: Twelve months of statements. Deep overdraft; repeated transfers to 'LC Holdings Ltd'.

analyses.label: Forensic accounting trace
analyses.findings: LC Holdings operates the Lantern Club card room: 1.1 million of gambling losses over two years. The insurer's own file shows the cover increase was requested by the insurer after a market revaluation.

addsLimitations.text: The insurer, not Ravel, requested the higher cover.

title: Irene Vance's studio accounts
description: Studio ledger and correspondence. 140,000 in arrears; invoices to the Ravel Gallery unpaid since 2024; a final demand from the bank.

points.note: Her studio is drowning in debt, much of it owed by the gallery.

analyses.label: Forensic accounting review
analyses.findings: The studio was insolvent by April. Her diary-ledger for next month carries a single incoming entry: '900,000 — on delivery (A.)'.

title: Freight manifest
description: Halden freight depot, Tuesday 08:40. One crate, 'restoration materials', consignor I. Vance, consignee a dealer in Antwerp. Declared value: 900,000.

points.note: She shipped 'restoration materials' worth 900,000 abroad the morning after returning the bird.

limitations.text: The crate was never opened or inspected.

title: Silicone mould from the studio
description: A two-part silicone mould of a small bird, with brass filings in the seams, found in a locked cabinet in Irene Vance's studio.
collection: Seized during a search of the studio.

points.note: A mould of a bird the size of the Nightingale, hidden in her studio.

limitations.text: Restorers make moulds to cast replacement parts.

analyses.label: Mould-to-replica comparison
analyses.findings: Seam lines, a casting bubble beneath the tail, and a tool slip on the left foot match the replica exactly. The vault bird was cast in this mould.

addsPoints.note: The replica in the vault was cast in the mould from her studio.

title: Lantern Club ledger and taxi record
description: The Lantern Club's members' book: L. Ravel signed in Wednesday 21:58, out 03:31. Taxi account: Lantern Club to Ravel's home, 03:40.

points.note: He was at a card club across town all Wednesday night.

limitations.text: The club is owed money by Ravel and its staff are not neutral.

title: Felix Dorn's diagnostic tablet
description: The tablet Felix Dorn uses to service the vault system. Its log for Wednesday 01:14–01:41 shows a motion sensor replaced and recalibrated; the display case contact sensor reports no opening all week except Monday 23:09 and Thursday 21:07.
collection: Imaged by the detective; original sealed.

points.note: The display case was never opened during his visit.
The case was opened on Monday night, when she returned the bird.

limitations.text: The log lives on his own device and could in principle have been edited.

title: Night guard's logbook
description: Pavel Novak's logbook. Mon 23:30 'I. Vance out, loading door, equipment case.' Wednesday: hourly rounds ticked 23:00 to 06:00.
collection: Seized from the desk; pages numbered.

points.note: Logged leaving with her equipment case on Monday night.

analyses.label: Ink and handwriting examination
analyses.findings: The Monday entry is contemporaneous. Every Wednesday tick was made in a single sitting with one pen at the end of the shift.

addsLimitations.text: The Wednesday rounds were filled in afterwards in a single sitting.

title: Irene Vance's phone records
description: Call records: three calls on Tuesday to a number registered to an Antwerp art dealer, and one on Wednesday evening, the day before the appraisal.

points.note: Repeated calls to the dealer the crate was shipped to.
